plan.name: Strategy 2: Direct Search to Target Location with Efficiency
plan.strategy: Directly search the most likely location for the apple (the fridge) first, then proceed to other areas if necessary. Focus on efficiency to avoid unnecessary steps.
steps: Check the fridge 1 for the presence of an apple.
If the apple is not found in the fridge, check countertop 1 and countertop 2.
If not found, search the cabinets (starting from cabinet 1) in order of likelihood.
Once the apple is located, verify if it is cool (if not, place it in the fridge to cool).
Finally, put the cool apple in garbagecan 1.
